title: chore(labeler): delete the inert `designer` rule and the exemption it needed (objectui#7771)
body:
Fixes #7771

Item 1 of that card only. Items 2 and 3 are answered, not worked — the reading is recorded below so the next sweep does not re-file them.

## What changed

Two deletions, both halves of the same defect:

1. `.github/labeler.yml` loses the `designer` rule (`packages/designer/**/*`). `packages/designer` was removed whole — its `package.json` was deleted in `21396ca4d` — so the rule has matched nothing since. Inert, not erroring: no run failed, nothing was mislabelled, and there was no symptom to notice.
2. `scripts/__tests__/labeler-package-coverage.test.ts` loses the named `UNRESOLVABLE_GLOB_EXEMPT` row that waived that rule. The list is now empty, which its own docblock calls the healthy state, and the "delete a package, forget the rule" direction is enforced with no waiver standing between it and the config. The docblock paragraph describing that direction is rewritten, because it stated as live a fact that the same commit makes historical.

The exemption's mechanism stays. Emptying the list is what the ruling asked for; removing the list would take away the reviewable way to declare a future waiver.

## Why A (delete) and not B (retarget)

Ruled on the card by the director seat (class-1 self-adjudication): B rests on `packages/plugin-designer` being the successor of the deleted `packages/designer`, and that relationship was explicitly **not measured** — the deletion commit does not say so. An unmeasured claim does not buy a retarget, and a retarget would silently change what the `designer` label means relative to every historical PR that carries it.

## Items 2 and 3 — ruled `no change`, recorded here so they are not re-filed

- **`plugin: chatbot`** — no rule added, label object kept. A sub-label for `packages/plugin-chatbot` has zero recorded pull, and that package is already visible to every sweep through the generic `plugin` label. Closing the four-of-twenty sub-label set to twenty is capability proliferation with nothing pulling on it.
- **`plugin-view`** — no rule added, label object kept. Same reading; `plugin: view` is item 2's proliferation under a different spelling.
- **No label object is touched by this PR at all.** This repo's convention for a label that leaves circulation is that *circulation* is what changes — the GitHub label object stays. A registry deletion also strips the label from every PR that ever carried it, and that is not revertible. Circulation is controlled by `.github/labeler.yml`, which is the only file here that moves.

## Measurements

All gate runs below are on `78555c2`.

**The coverage test's state, before and after.** The dispatch expected it to be red before this change. It was not:

| when | result |
|:--|:--|
| before any edit, unmodified `origin/main` tree | **green** — `Test Files 1 passed (1) · Tests 6 passed (6)`, exit 0 |
| after both halves land | **green** — 6 passed, exit 0 |

Green-before is the correct reading of the card's own sentence, which says the gate 「reddens the moment this card is resolved either way」: the exemption made it *honest* today, and it reddens when one half moves without the other. It was never red on `main`.

**Ablation — the gate is live, not vacuous.** Both legs mutate on disk, are proven to have landed (injected-text count plus a `git hash-object` comparison against the `HEAD` blob), run, and are restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; both files end byte-identical to `HEAD`.

| leg | mutation | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A | put the dangling rule back in `.github/labeler.yml`, exemption stays deleted | **red**, exit 1 — `never keeps a packages/ rule pointing at a directory that does not exist` |
| B | put an exemption row back in the test, rule stays deleted | **red**, exit 1 — `keeps both exemption lists honest` |

Each half alone fails, for its own assertion and its own reason. Neither test is passing vacuously after the deletion.

**Config still parses.** `.github/labeler.yml` parses with the same `yaml` library the gate uses: exit 0, 32 label keys, no `designer` key, no glob naming `packages/designer`. A labeler config that fails to parse is a broken gate, not a passing one, so this is measured rather than assumed.

**Gates run** (exit codes captured by redirecting to a file first, never read through a pipe):

| gate | exit |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/labeler-package-coverage.test.ts` | 0 |
| the three neighbouring pin tests that name this config, run together with it (`ci-cd-pipeline-doc`, `scripts-type-check`, `workflow-cache-save-bound`) — 116 tests | 0 |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 — no changeset owed; nothing published moved |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both paths | 0 — NOT GOVERNED |

`type-check:scripts` covers the edited test file by measurement, not by assumption: `tsc --listFiles` on `tsconfig.scripts.json` puts `labeler-package-coverage.test.ts` in the program (1 of the 1004 files that project compiles). That config deliberately does not inherit the tier-base `exclude`, which lists the test globs.

**Lint is narrowed, and the narrowing is declared.** `pnpm lint` is `turbo run lint`, which is driven by workspace package scripts and structurally cannot reach `scripts/` — the same reason `tsconfig.scripts.json` exists. ESLint was therefore run directly on the one `.ts` file this diff touches: 0 errors, 0 warnings, and `--format json` reports 1 file linted. The population that narrowing sits inside is read from ESLint's own config resolution, not guessed: `scripts/__tests__/**/*.ts` resolves to 188 files it covers there, 0 errors. Invariance for the untouched remainder: this repo's `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting — no `projectService`, no `parserOptions`, no `project`, no `tsconfigRootDir` anywhere in its 471 lines — so no edit in this diff can move ESLint's verdict on a file it does not contain. The repo-wide sweep is CI's run, not this one's.

**Adjacency, re-derived at PR time rather than at dispatch time.** All 17 open pull requests had their file lists enumerated to the end (PR #5400, the changeset release PR, across 17 pages and 1682 files). No open PR touches `.github/labeler.yml` and none touches `scripts/__tests__/labeler-package-coverage.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

Out-of-scope observations, noted and deliberately not filed:

- `.github/labeler.yml` carries a trailing space after `any-glob-to-any-file:` on the `documentation` rule. Pre-existing, parses fine, purely cosmetic — a style nit, not one of the three filing classes. Successor: the next PR that edits that rule for a real reason.
- `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` reports 1 disagreeing file at its held ceiling (objectui#7882). Unrelated to this diff, already carded, exits 0.

objectui#7746 is not addressed here and remains open on its own PR.
